data.title: Iron Breakpoint
data.style: Industrial heavy metal with a 132 BPM driving pulse, hard-locked double-kick battery, and distorted guitars chopping over a relentless machine groove; verse-equivalent sections stay hammered and riff-forward, the midsection opens to a lower, meaner chug before the final surge returns with stacked lead accents. Add impact hits on the first second, metallic scrapes into transitions, reverse cymbal swells before each lift, and sub-rattling tom fills between phrases. Mix is dark, heavy, and cinematic — wide, brutal, and punchy., stylized, industrial, metal, electric
